illustration_style: Continue the exact established picture-book illustration style shown in the primary reference: clearly defined irregular black pen-and-ink contours, short sharp fur hatching, visible watercolor grain inside the subjects, bright honey-golden fur, natural brown ceramics and clear blue accents. Preserve the reference bear's face, snout, proportions and original ink density. Use a genuinely transparent background with only a small muted green-gray patch of ground. No full background, yellow or sepia wash, paper rectangle, haze, vignette, soft painted outlines or desaturated fur. No text, lettering, speech bubbles or thought bubbles.

tea_party.title: もりの おちゃかい

opening.narration: もりの あきちで、プーが テーブルの ところに すわって いました。
opening.prompt: This bear from the reference image sits at a small wooden table in a forest clearing, with teacups, plates and a honey pot on the table and a blue balloon tied nearby, smiling as if welcoming a guest.

eeyore_birthday.title: イーヨーの おたんじょうび

opening.narration: 100エーカーの もりの あきちで、プーが テーブルの ところに すわって いました。
opening.prompt: This bear from the reference image sits at a small wooden table in a forest clearing, thinking with a paw on its chin. On the table are cups, plates and a full honey pot; colorful balloons and a ribbon lie nearby.

honey_gift_committed.narration: プーは、イーヨーへの おくりものを きめました。
honey_gift_committed.prompt: The seated bear gently holds an upright closed brown ceramic jar with both paws in its lap. The jar has a fitted lid and a small blue ribbon. The bear smiles quietly, pleased with the prepared gift. Its mouth and paws are clean.

pooh_tastes_honey.narration: プーは、ひとくちだけの つもりで、はちみつの つぼを もちだしました。
pooh_tastes_honey.prompt: The seated bear steadies an upright brown ceramic jar in its lap with one paw and lifts its lid with the other. Some amber honey is visible inside. It looks into the jar with a curious, gently tempted smile. Its mouth and paws are still clean.

pooh_ate_honey.narration: きが つくと、つぼの なかの はちみつは、すっかり なくなって いました。
pooh_ate_honey.prompt: This bear from the reference image sits with an empty honey pot tipped on its side in its lap, a little honey on its paw and mouth, looking surprised and a bit sorry.

story_wrap_up.narration: こうして、イーヨーへの おくりものが きまりました。
story_wrap_up.prompt: This bear from the reference image walks happily carrying a wrapped birthday present in one paw and waving goodbye with the other empty paw. No balloon or balloon string.

footprints.title: あしあとの しょうたい

opening.narration: ゆきが つもった もりの なかで、プーは みなれない あしあとを みつけました。
opening.prompt: This bear from the reference image stands at the edge of a snowy forest clearing beside a bush, looking down with curious interest at two small round footprints in the snow, one paw raised near its chin.

ask_appearance.narration: プーと あなたは、あしあとの ぬしの みための ことを はなしあいました。
ask_appearance.bubble_prompt:
A small, whimsical imaginary creature, the kind a daydreaming bear might picture as the maker of some mysterious tracks, matching this description of what it was imagined to look like: {description}
Match the exact same gentle, classic hand-illustrated picture-book tone as the rest of this book (a vintage E.H. Shepard-style Winnie-the-Pooh illustration): naturalistic, understated proportions, small normal-sized eyes (not large glossy anime/kawaii eyes), no exaggerated chibi cuteness. Drawn in clearly defined irregular black pen-and-ink contours, short sharp fur hatching, visible watercolor grain. Centered, filling most of the frame, genuinely transparent background, no scenery, no text.
ask_appearance.prompt: This bear from the reference image sits in the snow near a trail of footprints, looking up thoughtfully with one paw on its chin, imagining what kind of creature made them. A soft round thought bubble floats above its head, containing a small, cute drawing of an imagined fluffy creature in the same ink-and-watercolor style.

start_following.narration: プーと あなたは、あしあとを おいかけはじめました。
start_following.prompt: This bear from the reference image walks forward through the snow, leaning down slightly and pointing one paw at a trail of footprints leading off between the trees, with a determined, curious expression. The trail is made only of round paw-pad prints (the mystery creature's own tracks); no boot-shaped or shoe prints anywhere in this scene.

second_animal.narration: あしあとが ４つに ふえて、プーは びっくりしました。
second_animal.prompt: This bear from the reference image stops on the snowy trail and looks down with a surprised expression, one paw raised near its face, at two short parallel trails of footprints leading away to its lower right: a trail of exactly two round paw-pad prints closest to the bear (right where it is standing), and just beyond it, a little farther from the bear, a second trail of exactly two boot-shaped prints, both trails heading the same direction.

fourth_animal.narration: あしあとが もっと ふえて、８つに なりました。
fourth_animal.prompt: A bird's-eye view straight down onto plain white snow, empty except for footprints: four short, separate diagonal trails, scattered at irregular positions, angles and sizes across the frame (not a neat grid), each trail just a pair of a round paw-pad print and, right beside it, a narrow boot-shaped shoe print, as if two walkers went back and forth a few times. The paw-pad print must be a big, round, teddy-bear-sized pad with four small toe-pad bumps, the same size and roundness as the reference bear's own paw, not a small cat-like paw. Leave open white snow between the trails. Absolutely no bear, no person, no hand, no other object anywhere in the frame; only the footprints themselves, matching the reference illustration's ink-and-watercolor style.

reveal_direct.narration: プーは、あしあとが じぶんたちの ものだったと きづきました。
reveal_direct.prompt: This bear from the reference image crouches low and leans over, holding up its own round furry paw sole facing the viewer, next to a matching round paw-shaped footprint in the snow, comparing the two sizes by looking down at them with a surprised, sheepish smile. The raised paw's pads (the main pad and the toe-pads) must be warm brown/tan, the same warm brown as the bear's own nose -- not white or pale. Do not show the bear's hand or arm reaching toward anyone; this is the bear checking its own footprint against its own foot. A narrow boot-shaped print sits in the snow right next to the paw print, with no one reaching for it.

participant_presence: The person this bear is with (the reader) is never drawn as a whole figure: no face or body. When the scene has them handing, holding out or touching something, only their hand and forearm reach into the picture from its edge. Otherwise they are present only as a soft, faceless gray shadow falling into the scene from the bottom edge, as if the reader were standing just outside the picture.
